title: Repurposing dossier — saracatinib
brief: A medicinal-chemistry repurposing dossier arguing the case for saracatinib (AZD0530, ChEMBL217092 / PubChem CID 10302451), an AstraZeneca Src/Abl oncology inhibitor, as an ALK2 / ACVR1 kinase inhibitor for fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (OMIM 135100). The hero is the drug's real 2D structure, drawn client-side as black-line graphite ink with SmilesDrawer 2.1.7 from the verified ChEMBL canonical SMILES (CN1CCN(CCOc2cc(OC3CCOCC3)c3c(Nc4c(Cl)ccc5c4OCO5)ncnc3c2)CC1), with toggleable fragment/pharmacophore highlights (quinazoline hinge core, chloro-benzodioxole aniline, methylpiperazine solubiliser, tetrahydropyranyl-oxy). Beside it a med-chem property panel with real, sourced descriptors as labelled bars — MW 542.04, cLogP/ALogP 3.94 (XLogP 4.1), TPSA 90.4 Angstrom^2, HBD 1, HBA 10, rotatable bonds 8, aromatic rings 3, QED 0.45, Lipinski Ro5 PASS with a single MW violation — each hover-defined. Then the repurposing rationale (4-anilinoquinazoline scaffold, ATP-competitive type-I hinge binding, ALK2 IC50 15 nM cellular, selective over activin 72 nM / TGF-beta 305 nM and over ALK3/4/5/6, versus origin Src 2.7 nM / Abl 30 nM) in a measured-selectivity table; a schematic docking/binding rationale into the ACVR1 ATP pocket (kinase domain 208-502) naming the key residues (His286 hinge, Thr283 gatekeeper, Lys235 catalytic, Asp336 DFG, GS domain 178-207, R206H); the oncology to Alzheimer's-Fyn to FOP dual-repurposing timeline; and the clinical evidence trail with the real STOPFOP trial (NCT04307953, Phase 2, Amsterdam UMC, 100 mg saracatinib QD vs placebo, n=20 classic R206H, low-dose whole-body CT heterotopic-bone endpoint, NL/DE/UK). Every gene, protein, structure ID, SMILES, descriptor, potency, variant and trial fact is verified against UniProt (Q04771), RCSB PDB (5OXG), ChEMBL, PubChem, ClinicalTrials.gov and PubMed/PMC (JCI Insight 2018, BMC Musculoskelet Disord 2022, PMC11050334) on 3 July 2026, with a working reference list and an honest limits panel. Research and education, not medical advice.
da: Med-chem lab notebook — warm off-white paper with a faint graph-paper grain, graphite ink, the black-line 2D molecular structure as the clear hero; Space Grotesk display over Spline Sans Mono for descriptors, SMILES and residue notation; ONE deep aubergine/violet accent (#4a2c54) for property bars, section numbers and highlights, thin pencil hairlines, hand-numbered entries and a notebook seal; a chemist's notebook page, a different designer from the lab-white 3Dmol viewer, the light clinical graph and the warm-bone Literata dossier.
